sloka: स च एनम् अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् वैनतेयो महाबलः ।मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र वधो अयम् लोक सम्मतः ॥१-४१-१७॥
transliteration: sa ca enam abravīt vākyam vainateyo mahābalaḥ ।mā śucaḥ puruṣavyāghra vadho ayam loka sammataḥ ॥1-41-17॥

translations.english: Highly powerful Garuda, son of Vinata, addressing Anshuman said 'O Tiger among men do not grieve. This act of assasination is meant for the welfare of the three worlds'.
